about_short_description.short_description: Enhanced Radar is an Airlines and Aviation Technology firm offering AI for air traffic control.

product.name: Y2 AI Model
product.description: An AI model designed to accurately understand air traffic control speech communications for safety and operational support.

product.name: Pattern Platform
product.description: A platform built on Palantir technology that structures and analyzes air traffic control data to extract actionable insights.

product.name: Air Traffic Control Augmentation Systems
product.description: AI systems designed to assist air traffic controllers by monitoring operations and detecting potential human errors affecting aircraft separation.
